helpers.name: can_cast_caf

helpers.name: create_encore_granted_legacy

helpers.name: create_livio_legacy
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Creates the aegis legacy under the card owner, initializes the image and tracking, and exiles the target even when legacy creation returns-1. The int result is dead in the caller; returning the legacy index is inferred from the family API.

helpers.name: create_spell_has_flashback_legacy_for_hl
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Negative graveyard index returns. Graveyard owner is read from source targets0.player, independent of source controller; observed mode2 stored in targets2.player. Other mode values are source parameter forwarding, not independently proven.

helpers.reconstruction_notes: Searches six inst_info_data entries, stops at empty id, overwrites entry5 when full, clears payload on insertion, and returns the8-byte inst_info_t value in the native EDX:EAX shape. Native parent fast-path checks the first entry before the attributed fragment.

helpers.name: modify_casting_cost_for_colorless_only_mana
helpers.reconstruction_notes: EVENT_MODIFY_COST computes full generic+colorless cost at EVENT_CAST_SPELL, subtracts the colorless-only component for availability, then nulls or makes infinite. Other source-owner event paths belong outside this helper.

helpers.name: pay_aftermath
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Preserves separate X charging when colorless==-1 and updated cost is nonzero, zero-cost X uses-1 in charge_mana_multi, and records x_value before returning success. Observed event0xb5; forwarding other event values is not independently proven.

helpers.name: play_card_in_exile_for_free_and_exile_it
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Checks iid legality, removes exile card, adds it to the casting player hand, sets exile-on-resolution before casting, and corrects ownership for opposing controllers. Failed casting obliterates the added card. The caller discards the int result; forwarding real_play_spell_for_free success and zero on illegality is inferred from the native family.

helpers.name: prevent_all_damage_of_a_source_until_eot
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Uses a targeted legacy for in-play sources, untargeted otherwise. A successful legacy always stores the source pair; unattached effects additionally receive the source card name. Caller discards the result; returning the legacy index follows the family interface.

helpers.name: put_into_play_a_card_from_deck_tapped_and_attacking
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Observed player==t_player and deck_position0. Cage predicate precedes removal; then state0x14 and flags0x50000 before put_into_play. Generalizing player/t_player/deck_position follows abstract names and the parallel existing deck API. Ownership behavior for differing players cannot be recovered from this specialized instance and is not invented.

helpers.name: sac_at_beginning_of_next_end_step
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Preserves unguarded get_card_instance even on failed legacy creation. Clears number_of_targets byte0x36, then only for phase31 and nonnegative legacy sets targets1.player1. Caller discards return; legacy index is inferred.

helpers.name: select_a_card_from_deck_automatic
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Preserves the native Mindcensor starting position count_deck(targ_player)-4 and the loop bound count_deck(player), which can differ from the searched library controller.

helpers.name: special_null_casting_cost
helpers.reconstruction_notes: Subtracts updated generic cost and printed colored requirements; Hagra Mauling subtracts an extra generic when opponent has no basic lands. Native costs are byte stores; C assignments preserve truncation.

#define OP_BITWISE(T)	OP_BITWISE_CAST(T, int, SafeBool)
#define OP_BITWISE64(T)	OP_BITWISE_CAST(T, uint64_t, SafeBool64)
#define OP_BITWISE_CAST(T, Underlying, SafeBoolTyp)			\
inline constexpr T			operator| (T  lhs, T rhs)		\
{ return static_cast<T>(static_cast<Underlying>(lhs) | static_cast<Underlying>(rhs)); }	\
inline           T&			operator|=(T& lhs, T rhs)		\
{ return lhs = (lhs | rhs); }								\
inline constexpr T			operator^ (T  lhs, T rhs)		\
{ return static_cast<T>(static_cast<Underlying>(lhs) ^ static_cast<Underlying>(rhs)); }	\
inline           T&			operator^=(T& lhs, T rhs)		\
{ return lhs = (lhs ^ rhs); }								\
inline constexpr SafeBoolTyp<T>	operator& (T  lhs, T rhs)	\
{ return SafeBoolTyp<T>(static_cast<T>(static_cast<Underlying>(lhs) & static_cast<Underlying>(rhs))); }	\
inline           T&			operator&=(T& lhs, T rhs)		\
{ return lhs = (lhs & rhs); }								\
inline constexpr T			operator~ (T  v)				\
{ return static_cast<T>(~static_cast<Underlying>(v)); }		\
/**/
